assembly_order.step: 1 base shell upside down: adapter into its fence, M3 x 20 self-tappers from the deck top
1a pan drive on the bench: horn screwed into the pinion recess
1b pan drive on the bench: servo into the pocket + clamp, pinion onto the spline, centre screw through the pinion
1c pan drive onto the deck posts
2a floor plate on the bench: partition, MotorGo on its standoffs
2b floor plate on the bench: buck, servo controller
2c turntable on the bench: groove cap, posts from the turntable underside
2d thrust ring on the hub, turntable assembly into the deck hole; hub gear meshed under the deck and screwed up into the hub (floor still off)
3 floor into the shell, cables
6a pod on the bench: motor into the nacelle bore (crush ribs), body onto the nacelle plate; motor + nacelle screws from inside the guard; phase leads into the journal bore
6b magnet glued on the rear shaft with the jig (spigot in the 8 mm access hole); Plink on the cap pegs; encoder cap into the bore
6c hex stud head dropped into the backplate pocket (captive hex, never driven)
6d backplate into its bay, journal plate on (3 csk), hinge axle through wall + boss + plate into its trapped nut
6e thumbwheel onto the stud (set the gap), leaf screwed under the nip cover from outside, cover onto the land
6f flywheel onto the D-shaft, two pinch bolts through their nuts (L-key from +X)
6g wheel-side cover (4 csk)
7 pod drops into the post U-slots
8a tilt drive on the bench: horn screwed to the adapter
8b tilt drive on the bench: adapter + horn onto the servo spline, centre screw through the 6.5 key hole
8 tilt servo + horn adapter slide in -X through the right post (key into the journal-plate socket), cover
9 beam closes the journal U-slots
10a feeder drive on the bench: horn screwed into the pinion recess (M2 x 4)
10b crown upside down: pinion + horn in from below, servo #3 into its pocket from the top (spline into the horn), centre screw up through the pinion
10c disc in from below (band meshes with the pinion), floor plate on with 2 csk from below
10d feeder upright: bus into the channel, servo cover (2 csk)
11 feeder onto the beam
12 jar on the bench: adapter in the band, valve on the spout, gate
13 jar onto the feeder: drop in at +30, twist to 0
